description: Recorded subset of the NIC e-Way Bill API schema. Hand-derived golden used by ValidateEWayBill, in the same shape as nic_einvoice_schema.json. Not a full JSON-Schema; the validator in ewaybill_schema.go reads these constants.
provenance: SECONDARY. Derived from published API documentation summaries, NOT from a schema document held in this repository and NOT from a live NIC call — the portal is unreachable from this deployment. Contrast nic_einvoice_schema.json, which is the same grade. See rule138.go for the statutory figures and their identical caveat.
